issues.description: Supplementary Table 2, cited as the source of known marker genes for annotation of all 43 cell types, is not available in the provided markdown; markers for cell types without gene-embedded names (e.g., Alveolar macrophage, Alveolar type 1/2, Basal, Ciliated, NK, B cells, Plasma, etc.) could not be independently verified from the available text.

The paper does not annotate any pulmonary neuroendocrine cell type (the task's target L4 scope); no PNEC-specific markers were present. Under the revised scope, all other cell-type markers are retained and classified as 'outside' the four-layer PNS categories.

Annotation label 'CD8/NKT' includes CD8 as a marker gene and was added as a new finding for consistency with CD4; no other gene-symbol-embedded cell-type labels beyond the candidate list were identified in the available markdown.
